card.name: Web page notes and source credits
card.fires_on: Words inside website housekeeping text such as notes about old pages, reprint credits, copyright and permission notices, and addresses. It fires on ordinary words like page, this, a, the, for, is.

modes.label: Site note about a page
modes.description: Words in a note telling readers about a page, link or section of the site.
